title: Settings
description: Manage your account settings, preferences, appearance, and notifications.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This is how others will see you on the site.
profile.usernameHelp: This is your public display name. It can be your real name or a pseudonym.
profile.fullNameHelp: Your real name or formal company contact name.
profile.emailHelp: Your verified email address used for system security and recovery.
profile.phoneHelp: Contact number for account verification and critical notices.
profile.bioHelp: Brief description about yourself for your public workspace card.
profile.avatarHelp: JPG, WebP or PNG. Recommended size: 256x256.
profile.securitySectionDesc: Enhance account security by enabling two-factor verification (2FA) and updating your credentials.

billing.title: Billing Address
billing.subtitle: Customer billing details for invoices, tax computation, and payment verification.
billing.phoneHelp: Used for payment confirmation and invoice SMS notifications.
billing.emailHelp: Invoices and order confirmation receipts will be sent to this email.
billing.vatIdHelp: Used on B2B invoices for tax exemptions and reverse-charge VAT.

shipping.title: Shipping Address
shipping.subtitle: Delivery destination address for courier dispatches and physical shipments.
shipping.sameAsBillingDesc: Automatically synchronize shipping details with your billing address.
shipping.copiedFromBilling: Billing address copied into shipping fields!
shipping.notesPlaceholder: Notes about your order, e.g. special instructions for courier delivery.
shipping.notesHelp: Special courier instructions, gate access codes, or receiving hours.

addresses.title: Addresses Overview
addresses.description: The following addresses will be used on the checkout page by default.
addresses.billingCardDesc: Used for invoices and payment gateway validation.
addresses.shippingCardDesc: Used for courier dispatch and package delivery.

payment.title: Payment Methods
payment.subtitle: Manage saved credit cards, PayPal accounts, and bank transfers for billing.
payment.savedMethodsDesc: Cards and accounts used for subscriptions, invoice settlements, and store checkouts.
payment.noMethodsDesc: Add a credit or debit card, PayPal, or direct bank transfer to pay for invoices and subscriptions.
payment.securityNote: All transactions are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption and processed through PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant gateways. Card numbers are never stored in plain text.
payment.dialogDesc: Securely link a new payment option to your user profile.
payment.paypalHelp: Ensure this matches your verified PayPal account. A confirmation will be sent upon linking.
payment.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to remove this payment method? Recurring subscriptions will require an alternate method.
payment.addedDesc: Your new payment method is verified and ready for checkout.
payment.deletedDesc: The payment method has been removed from your profile.

account.title: Account
account.description: Update your account preferences, preferred language, and regional formats.
account.dobHelp: Your date of birth is used to calculate age eligibility.
account.languageHelp: This will be the default language across all your dashboards and reports.
account.deleteAccountWarning: Permanently delete your account and all associated data.

appearance.title: Appearance & Theme
appearance.description: Customize the look and feel of your dashboard. Changes apply live and save automatically.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Configure how you receive activity notifications and operational digests.
notifications.communicationEmailsDesc: Receive emails about your account activity and project mentions.
notifications.marketingEmailsDesc: Receive promotional messages about new features, updates, and releases.
notifications.socialNotificationsDesc: Get notified when contacts message you or add you to workspace teams.
notifications.securityAlertsDesc: Critical notifications about unrecognized login sessions or API key changes.

display.title: Display
display.description: Turn items on or off to control what's displayed in the sidebar navigation.
display.sidebarItemsDesc: Select the sections you want visible in the primary navigation rail.

security.title: Security & Authentication
security.description: Protect your account with two-factor authentication (2FA) and keep your password secure.
security.overviewProtectedDesc: Two-factor authentication is active. Your account is secured with multi-factor verification.
security.overviewUnprotectedDesc: 2FA is currently disabled. Enable an authenticator app to prevent unauthorized access.
security.passwordDescription: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure.
security.passwordRequirementsHint: Must contain uppercase, numbers, and symbols.
security.passwordUpdateError: Failed to update password. Please check your current password.
security.twoFactorDescription: Add an extra layer of security requiring an authenticator code when signing in.
security.authenticatorActiveDesc: Verification codes from your mobile authenticator app will be required during login.
security.enablePromptDesc: Protect your account from unauthorized access by requiring a verification code generated by Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Authy on your mobile phone.
security.sessionsDescription: Devices currently logged in to your account. Revoke any unrecognized sessions immediately.
security.auditLogDescription: Recent authentication attempts, password modifications, and security events.
security.step1Desc: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, or 1Password).
security.step2Desc: Enter the 6-digit confirmation code generated by your authenticator app.
security.step3Desc: Store your emergency backup recovery codes in a secure location.
security.scanQrInstruction: Point your phone camera or authenticator scanner at this QR code.
security.manualKeyLabel: Can't scan? Enter this secret key manually into your app:
security.enterCodeInstruction: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code shown for AdminKit.
security.twoFactorInvalidCode: Invalid verification code. Please check and try again.
security.testCodeHint: Tip: You can use any 6-digit code (e.g. 123456) in preview mode.
security.backupCodesWarning: Save these recovery codes now. If you lose access to your device, each code can be used once to access your account.
security.acknowledgeSavedCheckbox: I have downloaded or written down these backup recovery codes in a safe place.
security.backupCodesModalDesc: These one-time codes can be used to log in if you lose access to your authenticator app.
security.disable2FAModalDesc: Disabling 2FA will reduce your account security. Please confirm your current password to proceed.
security.invalidPassword: The password you entered is incorrect.
